examples.text: An unknown person has used the large public planter as a place to discard household refuse. There are food wrappers and household bags packed into it.
Someone tipped renovation waste onto the public green. I also have a separate question about which plastics can be recycled at home.
What are the disposal facility's opening hours on a weekday?
Could you suggest how to keep food scraps from smelling between normal collections?
I waited until the end of collection day to check. The designated refuse container at our building has not been serviced at all.
Furniture has been tipped into the creek behind the recreation ground. A neighbour witnessed it being pushed from a vehicle.
I witnessed a business tipping its refuse into the park's public litter container without permission, instead of arranging disposal. I want to report that action.
Following this morning's collection visit, the bottom section of the container is still packed with refuse. I am reporting that it was only partly emptied.
This is the second scheduled round in succession when our household rubbish has been left behind. Could this recurring failure be recorded?
Access to our refuse container was restored before the scheduled vehicle arrived, but the operator passed it without taking the contents. I want to report the skipped pickup.
We have just moved into a newly built home. How do we register for the normal waste service?
I saw a contractor discharge a load of broken plasterboard down the riverbank instead of using a disposal facility. Please record this report.
I found a tag on my refuse container after the round. Its contents were not taken. Please log the uncompleted collection; I am not asking you to decide whether a return visit is owed.
The last expected pickup did not happen for our property. Separately, please explain the waste-service fee on my account.
There is a newly abandoned heap of demolition rubble on the empty lot; I saw people carrying it from a renovation and leaving it there.
Something went wrong with the waste service today. Can you look into it?
Could you reopen my previous waste case? I do not have any other details here.
Our empty rubbish container disappeared from the garage. How do I request a replacement for a stolen container?
Two discarded washing machines have been abandoned across the cycle path. They were not placed there for an arranged collection.
Somebody has dumped unwanted household belongings in the public stairwell by the pedestrian bridge. Please take a report about that incident.
I want to change to a smaller household waste container. What is the process for requesting a size change?
An old television has been deliberately discarded in the flower bed at the park entrance. It is not awaiting any scheduled pickup.
Every waste container at our small apartment building was skipped on the advertised collection day, although the rest of the block was served.
I need to report a discarded freezer deliberately left on the public footpath, and I would also like instructions for registering for an exercise class.
Can clean aluminium foil go into household recycling? I only need sorting advice.
Someone used our construction skip without permission to get rid of their household rubbish. We are reporting that disposal incident, not a problem with the collection round.
Nobody has left extra rubbish at our home. The issue is that the booked waste round failed to empty our container.
How can I register my child for municipal swimming lessons?
Please explain how the waste-service charge is calculated for different container sizes.
I am planning ahead for next month's public holiday and need the revised service calendar. There has been no failed pickup.
The collection vehicle took the waste from one compartment of our shared container and drove away leaving the other compartment full. This is a report about that incomplete service.
Any update on our waste request? We are still waiting.
Could you log an uncompleted scheduled rubbish pickup? I can supply the service location when you contact me.
The neighbours told us to contact you about the refuse situation, but I do not know what happened.
Please see the attachment about the rubbish issue. I need help with it.
Our scheduled refuse service left the full container behind. In a separate matter, another container has been stolen and needs replacement.
A load of domestic waste has been deliberately thrown into the hedge surrounding the sports field. It is not material waiting for our normal service.
The vehicle stopped at the property next door instead of ours during yesterday's round. Our container was never serviced.
